between_regime_interaction_tests_competi.interpretation_note: Gelman-Stern (2006) direct interaction test: within-subgroup significance in Competing-Corridor plus non-significance in Standard does NOT establish a statistically significant difference between regimes unless Competing-minus-Standard itself is significant.
